note: Default suggested replies (English and Taglish). Shared by the server (services/replies.py) and the browser demo. Teams can edit, add and remove templates in the app. Replies are copied, never sent automatically.

templates.title: Thank you for traveling with us
templates.body: Thank you so much for your kind words! We're so happy you enjoyed your trip. Our team will be glad to hear this. We hope to see you on your next adventure!

templates.title: Salamat sa pagbiyahe
templates.body: Maraming salamat po sa magandang feedback! Masaya kami na nag-enjoy kayo sa trip ninyo. Ipaparating po namin ito sa buong team. Sana makasama ulit namin kayo sa susunod na biyahe!

templates.title: Sorry for the delay
templates.body: We're very sorry for the delay and the long wait. We are checking with our driver and coordinator right now and will send you an update within the hour. Thank you for your patience.

templates.title: Pasensya sa delay
templates.body: Pasensya na po talaga sa delay at sa matagal na paghihintay. Kinakausap na po namin ngayon ang driver at coordinator namin, at magbibigay kami ng update within the hour. Salamat po sa pag-unawa.

templates.title: Refund follow-up
templates.body: Thank you for following up, and sorry this is taking long. We have forwarded your refund request to our accounting team. Could you send us your booking name and payment reference so we can give you an exact update?

templates.title: Update sa refund
templates.body: Salamat po sa pag-follow up, at pasensya na po kung natatagalan. Naipasa na po namin sa accounting ang refund request ninyo. Pakisend po ang booking name at payment reference para mabigyan namin kayo ng eksaktong update.

templates.title: Lost passport: first steps
templates.body: We're so sorry this happened. Please stay calm, we will help you. First, please file a police report at the nearest station and keep a copy. Send us your current location and a contact number so our team can call you right away and coordinate with the embassy.

templates.title: Nawalang passport: unang gagawin
templates.body: Pasensya na po at nangyari ito. Huwag po kayong mag-alala, tutulungan namin kayo. Una po, mag-file ng police report sa pinakamalapit na station at itago ang kopya. Pakisend po ang location ninyo ngayon at contact number para matawagan namin kayo agad at makipag-coordinate sa embassy.

templates.title: Booking confirmation
templates.body: Thank you for booking with us! We're checking your booking now and will send your confirmation and travel documents to your email shortly. If you don't receive them within the day, please message us again with your booking name.

templates.title: Confirmation ng booking
templates.body: Salamat po sa pag-book sa amin! Chine-check na po namin ang booking ninyo at ipapadala namin ang confirmation at travel documents sa email ninyo. Kung wala pa po sa loob ng araw na ito, paki-message ulit kami kasama ang booking name.

templates.title: Answering a question
templates.body: Hi! Thank you for your interest. Could you tell us your preferred travel dates and how many travelers are in your group? We'll send you the details and the latest rates right away.

templates.title: Sagot sa tanong
templates.body: Hi po! Salamat sa interest ninyo. Pwede po ba naming malaman ang preferred travel dates ninyo at ilan kayo sa group? Ipapadala po namin agad ang details at latest rates.

templates.title: Emergency: we're on it
templates.body: We're very sorry. Your safety comes first. Please send us your exact location and a contact number now. Our team is calling our operator on site and will call you within a few minutes.

templates.title: Emergency: inaasikaso na
templates.body: Pasensya na po talaga. Ang safety ninyo ang pinakamahalaga. Pakisend po agad ang exact location ninyo at contact number. Tinatawagan na po namin ang operator sa lugar at tatawagan namin kayo sa loob ng ilang minuto.

templates.title: Hotel problem
templates.body: We're sorry your room is not as expected. We are calling the hotel's front desk now to ask for a room change or an immediate fix. We'll update you shortly. If it can't be fixed today, we'll arrange another option for you.

templates.title: Problema sa hotel
templates.body: Pasensya na po at hindi maayos ang room ninyo. Tinatawagan na po namin ang front desk ng hotel para sa room change o agarang ayos. Mag-a-update po kami agad. Kung hindi maayos ngayong araw, aayusin namin ang ibang option para sa inyo.

templates.title: Visa status update
templates.body: Thank you for checking in. We're following up on your visa application now and will send you an update within the day. Please keep your phone close in case the embassy needs more documents.

templates.title: Update sa visa
templates.body: Salamat po sa pag-check. Fina-follow up na po namin ngayon ang visa application ninyo at magbibigay kami ng update ngayong araw. Paki-ready lang po ng phone kung sakaling may hihinging dagdag na documents ang embassy.

templates.title: Sincere apology
templates.body: We're truly sorry about your experience. This is not the service we want for our travelers. Could you send us your booking name so we can look into what happened and make it right?

templates.title: Paumanhin
templates.body: Taos-puso po kaming humihingi ng paumanhin sa naging experience ninyo. Hindi po ito ang serbisyong gusto namin para sa aming travelers. Pakisend po ang booking name para maimbestigahan namin at maayos ito.

templates.title: Thanks for reaching out
templates.body: Hi! Thank you for your message. A member of our team will get back to you shortly.

templates.title: Salamat sa message
templates.body: Hi po! Salamat sa message ninyo. Babalikan po kayo agad ng isa sa aming team.
